claude-haiku-4-5.source: Anthropic Effort docs (docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/effort): the 'Supported models' list for effort is Fable 5/5.1, Mythos 5/5.1/Preview, Opus 4.5-4.8/5/5.5, Sonnet 4.6/5/5.5 and Haiku 5.5 — Haiku 4.5 is not on it, so it has no effort parameter. It still reasons (adaptive budget_tokens), which is why the picker must stay off rather than offer guessed rungs.

claude-opus-4-5.source: Anthropic Effort docs: 'On Claude Opus 4.5, the only extended-thinking-only model that supports effort, it works alongside budget_tokens'. The level table lists max/xhigh as model-gated and high as the default on every effort-capable model except Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, which leaves low/medium/high for Opus 4.5; models.dev provider opencode independently lists effort values low/medium/high for this model.

claude-sonnet-4-5.source: Anthropic Effort docs (docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/effort): Sonnet 4.5 is absent from the effort 'Supported models' list (Sonnet 4.6/5/5.5 are listed). It reasons with a budget_tokens ceiling, so the picker stays off. models.dev provider opencode also shows only budget_tokens for it, no effort values.

qwen3.5-plus.source: Alibaba Model Studio deep-thinking docs (help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deep-thinking): qwen3.5-plus is hybrid thinking, on by default; length is steered with enable_thinking / thinking_budget and reasoning_effort is named without a published rung list. Conservative low/medium/high, the same ladder commandcode-goat-provider records for the Qwen3.x Plus line.

qwen3.6-plus.source: Same Qwen3.x Plus line as qwen3.5-plus: Alibaba deep-thinking docs list qwen3.6-plus as hybrid thinking with thinking on by default; no published rung enumeration, so low/medium/high as recorded in commandcode-goat-provider for Qwen/Qwen3.6-Plus.

qwen3.8-flash.source: Alibaba deep-thinking docs list qwen3.8-flash as hybrid thinking; pi-ai openrouter:qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902 carries an explicit thinkingLevelMap low/medium/high/xhigh (max:null) for the Qwen3.8 line. models.dev provider opencode shows low/medium/xhigh — missing 'high' for the high:null data-entry reason commandcode-goat-provider documented.

qwen3.8-max.source: Same Qwen3.8 line: pi-ai openrouter:qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902 explicit thinkingLevelMap low/medium/high/xhigh; Alibaba docs list qwen3.8-max as hybrid thinking. models.dev provider opencode exposes a toggle only, so it offered no ladder to copy.

big-pickle.source: OpenCode's own free stealth model: pi-ai opencode:big-pickle has reasoning:true with no map, models.dev provider opencode lists no reasoning options, and there is no vendor documentation to consult. Recording an empty ladder rather than guessing — revisiting needs a live probe against the Zen API with an API key.

glm-5.source: Z.AI thinking docs (docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/thinking): reasoning_effort control is 'only supported by GLM-5.2 and above'; GLM-5 has deep thinking with thinking.type enabled/disabled but no effort parameter. Recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for zai-org/GLM-5.

glm-5.1.source: Z.AI thinking docs: reasoning_effort is 'only supported by GLM-5.2 and above' — GLM-5.1 exposes thinking.type enabled/disabled but no effort parameter. Recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for zai-org/GLM-5.1.

kimi-k2.5.source: Moonshot Kimi API docs (platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-kimi-k2-thinking-model): reasoning_effort is kimi-k3 only; kimi-k2.6 and kimi-k2.5 take thinking.type enabled/disabled with no effort rungs. Recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5.

kimi-k2.6.source: Moonshot Kimi API docs: kimi-k2.6 has thinking on by default and can be disabled, but its reasoning_effort column reads 'Not supported' (K3-only). No ladder to expose, recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6.

kimi-k2.7-code.source: Moonshot Kimi API docs: kimi-k2.7-code has thinking always on (thinking.type accepts only "enabled") and reasoning_effort 'Not supported'. Recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.source: Preview build in the LongCat 2.5 line; Meituan publishes no rung list and models.dev provider opencode exposes a reasoning toggle only. Carrying the LongCat 2.0 family ladder low/medium/high that commandcode-goat-provider recorded.

mimo-v2.6-flash-free.source: Free serving tier of mimo-v2.6-flash; same Xiaomi MiMo ladder (vendor docs reasoning.effort low/medium/high, none closes thinking) as the paid id, which the owner curated in DSH plugin commit df6c41d and commandcode-goat-provider records for xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash.

minimax-m2.5.source: MiniMax family ladder recorded in commandcode-goat-provider for MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5 (probe 2026-10-02 there: reasons by default, off rejected; MiniMax platform docs); pi-ai opencode:minimax-m2.5 has reasoning:true with no map and models.dev opencode shows no effort options.

minimax-m2.7.source: Same MiniMax family ladder as M2.5/M3, recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7; pi-ai opencode:minimax-m2.7 is reasoning:true with no map.

minimax-m3.source: MiniMax family ladder recorded in commandcode-goat-provider for MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 (probe there 2026-10-02: high rung reacted, off rejected); MiniMax docs describe 'tunable thinking depth' only for M3.1-Flash, so the wider low..max ladder is not claimed here. pi-ai opencode:minimax-m3 is reasoning:true with no map.

nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.source: NVIDIA Nemotron reasoning parameters (OpenRouter supported_parameters includes reasoning with low/medium/high effort); commandcode-goat-provider records the same low/medium/high for nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl. pi-ai opencode:nemotron-3.5-lightning-free is reasoning:true with no map.
